استعرتا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَعَرَتَا (istaʕaratā) /is.ta.ʕa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# اُسْتُعِرَتَا (ustuʕiratā) /us.tu.ʕi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
